description.en: Planned animal asset: long toothed bill and large perching feet.
description.zh: 规划中的动物资产：长有齿喙与大型栖握足。

scientific_scope.en: Living reconstruction proposal, not a scanned specimen. Only a group-level reference has been verified here. Taxon-specific identity, interval and proposed distinguishing anatomy remain unverified; do not start production. Bird-form bucket includes stem avialans.
scientific_scope.zh: 活体复原方案，并非扫描标本。本次仅核实类群层级资料。具体分类单元、时代及拟议鉴别形态仍待专门核实；不得开始制作。 鸟形分类栏也包含干群鸟翼类。

distinctness.en: Shape criterion: long toothed bill and large perching feet. Retain this anatomical combination when compared with nearby forms; a name, scale or pose change alone does not qualify.
distinctness.zh: 形态判据：长有齿喙与大型栖握足。须与相近形态对照保留这一结构组合；仅改名称、尺寸或姿态不成立。

modeling_brief.en: Original low-poly brief: block long toothed bill and large perching feet with a small number of readable masses; preserve negative spaces and joint transitions. Use a restrained neutral palette; simplify surface texture only after the silhouette reads. Validate the diagnostic feature before detailed geometry.
modeling_brief.zh: 原创低多边形说明：用少量清晰体块组织长有齿喙与大型栖握足；保留负空间与关节过渡。采用克制的中性色；轮廓成立后再简化表面纹理。精细几何制作前须核实鉴别特征。

uncertainty: Skin, color and unpreserved soft tissues are not established by this inventory. Choose a species and specimen before final anatomy approval. The cited overview is not a verification of this genus or its distinctive feature.

reference_notes.en: Research candidate only. Group citation is deliberately not a claim of taxon-level verification.
reference_notes.zh: 仅为研究候选；类群引用有意不表示具体分类单元已获核实。

sources.title: What were the first birds like?
sources.supports: Archaeopteryx bony tail, teeth and wing claws; bird-lineage concepts and uncertainty in the bird/non-bird boundary.
